description_en: Retrieves information about one or more backup clients that meet the specified conditions
description_zh: 获取一个或者多个符合条件的备份客户端信息
name: DescribeBackupClients

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the backup client. Valid values:
ECS_CLIENT: ECS File Backup client.
CONTAINER_CLIENT: container backup client.
LOCAL_CLIENT: local NAS backup, CPFS backup, archive, or data synchronization client
parameters.help_zh:
备份客户端类型。取值：
ECS_CLIENT，表示ECS文件备份客户端。
CONTAINER_CLIENT，表示容器备份客户端。
LOCAL_CLIENT，表示本地NAS备份/CPFS备份/归档/数据同步客户端
parameters.name: client_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The list of backup client IDs
parameters.name: client_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of ECS instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_ids

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the backup vault. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. 
The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
The tag key cannot be an empty string
fields.help_zh:
仓库的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

不支持以`aliyun`、`acs:`开头。 
不允许包含`http://`和`https://` 。
不允许为空字符串
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the backup vault. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. 
The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
The tag value cannot be an empty string
fields.help_zh:
仓库的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。

不支持以`aliyun`、`acs:`开头。 
不允许包含`http://`和`https:// `。
不允许为空字符串
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values: 
SELF_ACCOUNT: backup within the current account. 
CROSS_ACCOUNT: cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account used for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role created in the source account for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

fields.help_en: The key of the query filter
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The values to match in the query filter
fields.help_zh: 查询过滤器中的待匹配的值
fields.name: values

Appliance.description_en:
Indicates whether the client is a hardware monitoring appliance client.

true: The client is a hardware monitoring appliance client.
false: The client is not a hardware monitoring appliance client
Appliance.description_zh:
是否是硬件监控一体机客户端。

true表示是硬件监控一体机客户端。
false表示不是硬件监控一体机客户端

ArchType.description_en:
This parameter is valid only when ClientType is set to ECS_CLIENT. The system architecture of the backup client. Valid values:
amd64
386
ArchType.description_zh:
仅当ClientType取值为ECS_CLIENT时，该参数有效。表示备份客户端所在的系统架构。取值范围：
amd64
386

BackupStatus.description_en:
The protection status of the backup client. Valid values:
UNPROTECTED: The server is not protected.
PROTECTED: The server is protected
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份客户端受保护状态。取值范围：
UNPROTECTED：服务器未受保护
PROTECTED：服务器已受保护

ClientId.description_en: The ID of the backup client

ClientType.description_en: The type of the backup client. The value ECS_CLIENT indicates an ECS File Backup client
ClientType.description_zh: 备份客户端类型。取值为ECS_CLIENT，表示ECS文件备份客户端

ClientVersion.description_en: The version number of the backup client

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup client was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 备份客户端创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

Hostname.description_en: The hostname of the backup client
Hostname.description_zh: 备份客户端所在的主机名

InstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID.

If the client type is ECS File Backup client, this parameter indicates the ECS instance ID.
If the client type is local file backup client, this parameter indicates the hardware fingerprint generated based on system information
InstanceId.description_zh:
实例ID。

当客户端类型为ECS文件备份客户端时，表示ECS实例ID。
当客户端类型为本地文件备份客户端时，表示根据系统信息生成的硬件指纹

InstanceName.description_en: This parameter is valid only when ClientType is set to ECS_CLIENT. The name of the ECS instance
InstanceName.description_zh: 仅当ClientType取值为ECS_CLIENT时，该参数有效。表示ECS实例名称

LastHeartBeatTime.description_en: The time of the last heartbeat of the backup client. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
LastHeartBeatTime.description_zh: 备份客户端最后一次心跳时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

MaxClientVersion.description_en: The latest version number of the backup client
MaxClientVersion.description_zh: 最新备份客户端版本号

OsType.description_en:
This parameter is valid only when ClientType is set to ECS_CLIENT. The operating system type of the client. Valid values:
windows
linux
OsType.description_zh:
仅当ClientType取值为ECS_CLIENT时，该参数有效。表示客户端系统类型。取值范围：
windows
linux

PrivateIpV4.description_en: This parameter is valid only when ClientType is set to ECS_CLIENT. The internal IP address of the ECS instance
PrivateIpV4.description_zh: 仅当ClientType取值为ECS_CLIENT时，该参数有效。表示ECS实例内网IP地址

Settings.description_en: The configuration information of the backup client

AlertOnPartialComplete.description_en: Specifies whether to send alerts for partially completed jobs. This setting applies only to File Backup and ECS File Backup Essential Edition
AlertOnPartialComplete.description_zh: 是否针对部分完成任务告警，仅针对本地文件备份和ECS文件备份标准版生效

DataNetworkType.description_en:
The type of the data plane endpoint. Valid values:

PUBLIC: public network.
VPC: VPC network.
CLASSIC: classic network
DataNetworkType.description_zh:
数据面数据接入点类型。取值范围：

PUBLIC：公网
VPC：VPC网络
CLASSIC：经典网络

DataProxySetting.description_en:
The data plane proxy setting. Valid values:

DISABLE: No proxy is used.
USE_CONTROL_PROXY (default): The same configuration as the control plane is used.
CUSTOM: A custom configuration is used (HTTP protocol)
DataProxySetting.description_zh:
数据面代理设置。取值范围：

DISABLE：不使用代理
USE_CONTROL_PROXY（默认）：与控制面配置相同
CUSTOM：自定义配置（HTTP协议）

MaxCpuCore.description_en: The number of CPU cores used by a single backup job. A value of 0 indicates no limit
MaxCpuCore.description_zh: 单个备份任务使用的CPU核数，0表示不限制

MaxMemory.description_en: The maximum memory that the client can use. Unit: bytes. Only versions 2.13.0 and later are supported
MaxMemory.description_zh: 客户端能够使用的最大内存，单位是bytes。仅支持2.13.0及以上版本

MaxWorker.description_en: The number of concurrent workers for a single backup job. A value of 0 indicates no limit
MaxWorker.description_zh: 单个备份任务并发工作数量，0表示不限制

ProxyHost.description_en: The IP address of the custom data plane proxy server
ProxyHost.description_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器主机IP地址

ProxyPassword.description_en: The password of the custom data plane proxy server
ProxyPassword.description_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器密码

ProxyPort.description_en: The port of the custom data plane proxy server
ProxyPort.description_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器主机端口

ProxyUser.description_en: The username of the custom data plane proxy server
ProxyUser.description_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器用户名

UseHttps.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTPS is used to transmit data plane data.

true: HTTPS is used for transmission.
false: HTTP is used for transmission
UseHttps.description_zh:
是否使用HTTPS传输数据面数据。

true表示使用HTTPS传输。
false表示使用HTTP传输

Status.description_en:
The status of the backup client. Valid values:
REGISTERED: The client is registered.
ACTIVATED: The client is activated.
DEACTIVATED: The client activation has expired.
INSTALLING: The client is being installed.
INSTALL_FAILED: The client installation failed.
NOT_INSTALLED: The client is not installed.
UPGRADING: The client is being upgraded.
UPGRADE_FAILED: The client upgrade failed.
UNINSTALLING: The client is being uninstalled.
UNINSTALL_FAILED: The client uninstallation failed.
STOPPED: The client service is stopped.
UNKNOWN: The client is disconnected
Status.description_zh:
备份客户端状态。取值范围：
REGISTERED：注册成功
ACTIVATED：激活成功
DEACTIVATED：激活失效
INSTALLING：安装中
INSTALL_FAILED：安装失败
NOT_INSTALLED：未安装
UPGRADING：升级中
UPGRADE_FAILED：升级失败
UNINSTALLING：卸载客户端中
UNINSTALL_FAILED：卸载客户端失败
STOPPED：客户端服务已停止
UNKNOWN：客户端失联

Key.description_en:
The tag key of the backup vault. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. 
The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
The tag key cannot be an empty string
Key.description_zh:
仓库的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

不支持以`aliyun`、`acs:`开头。 
不允许包含`http://`和`https://` 。
不允许为空字符串

Value.description_en:
The tag value of the backup vault. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. 
The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
The tag value cannot be an empty string
Value.description_zh:
仓库的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。

不支持以`aliyun`、`acs:`开头。 
不允许包含`http://`和`https:// `。
不允许为空字符串

UpdatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup client was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 备份客户端更新时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

ZoneId.description_en: This parameter is valid only when ClientType is set to ECS_CLIENT. The zone ID
ZoneId.description_zh: 仅当ClientType取值为ECS_CLIENT时，该参数有效。表示地域

Message.description_en: The returned message. The value "successful" is returned for successful requests. An error message is returned for failed requests
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of backup clients that meet the specified conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的符合条件的备份客户端总数
